concepts.def: The basic building block from which all living organisms are made.
A group of cells with a similar structure and function.
An aggregation of tissues performing specific functions.
A group of organs that organs are organised into; organ systems work together to form organisms.

mcqs.q: A structure in an organism is made up of several different tissues that work together to carry out a specific function. Which level of organisation is this structure?
options: a tissue, a group of similar cells
an organ system, a group of organs
an organ, an aggregation of tissues
an organism, a group of organ systems
mcqs.explain: Correct: organs are aggregations of tissues performing specific functions, which is exactly what the structure described is.

mcqs.q: Which statement about organ systems in a living organism is correct?
options: Organ systems are made of one organ with one function.
Organ systems are made of cells grouped together.
Organ systems are made of one tissue with a function.
Organ systems are made of organs that work together.
mcqs.explain: Correct: organs are organised into organ systems, which work together to form organisms.
